scope: Existing catalog links only. No media downloads, no catalog/UI edits, no complete-playback verification.

definitions.canonicalEpisode: A distinct named Shalom Sesame home-video program; duplicates, broadcast edits, songs and trailers are not additional episodes.
definitions.title-verified candidate: An existing single-upload whole-episode candidate with title or primary-numbering evidence; media completeness remains unreviewed.
definitions.complete-upload linked: Reserved for a single-upload edition whose actual program identity and complete playback have been checked; none reached that status in this metadata audit.
definitions.parts-only: No single whole-upload candidate; one or more explicitly labeled episode parts are linked.
definitions.missing: No single whole-upload candidate and no episode-part upload. Short studio scenes or trailers may still be linked.
definitions.wholeUploadCandidatePolicy: Use a canonical episode title or primary-numbered identity and long-form runtime. Two substantially shorter than reference editions are tracked separately. Runtime alone never proves completeness.
definitions.runtimeComparisons: Library runtimes are approximate and editions vary; shorter runtimes are a review flag, not proof that an upload is missing scenes.
definitions.yearComparisons: Production/copyright year, original home-video release and later dubbed/broadcast dates differ. Secondary rollout years are labeled provisional rather than merged into primary program-year fields.
